text.p: Marshalltown Financial Corp said on Friday it has signed a forbearance agreement with BancSecurity Corp, which agreed last year to acquire Marshalltown for $24.7 million or $16.75 a share.
The deal provides BancSecurity with time to get Federal Reserve approval for the deal, Marshalltown said.

Under the forbearance agreement, the shareholders would receive $24.7 million total, which will be increased at a rate of six percent per year from September 30, 1996 through the date of closing or a date that BancSecurity is able to close the deal, Marshalltown said.
BancSecurity will pay $75,000 to Marshalltown if the deal is not completed, except for a breach of contract by Marshalltown.
Marshalltown has agreed not to termiate the deal until December 13, 1995, unless BancSecurity gets approval from the Federal Reserve to complete the deal, the bank said.
If BancSecurity gets approval from the Federal Reserve, then Marshalltown will extend the termination date until January 15, 1997, Marshalltown said.
